description: MISO2 models material inputs, stocks and outputs from extraction through use and waste management, with country-level applications. The cited provider is BOKU University. The documented country-level application spans 177 countries from 1900 to 2016; model scenarios can use other supplied inputs. Access starts from public repository documentation and source-code metadata. The inspected metadata names the GPL-3.0 licence. The source or documentation can be inspected without a fee; reuse still depends on licensing. Documentation does not establish completeness, calibration quality or suitability for a particular simulation. For infrastructure simulation, it can support mineral-processing or mine-operation scenario development.
